free_tier.stated: No free tier: NT$10 per item, '24小時内交貨', 998 in stock at the time of reading.

per_object_cap.stated: Not published. The listing sells '各式網盤代下資源' by the item.

egress.terms: NT$10 per item, delivered within 24 hours. Covers 百度/夸克/騰訊/迅雷/阿里雲/115/UC/城通/天翼/飛貓/微雲/移動/堅果/小飛機.

interface_detail: Marketplace chat; delivery is a message, no API.
tooling: 8591 web/app, Taiwanese payment rails (7-11, ATM, 玉山帳户).
chaining: The same 代下 job priced in TWD and delivered on a 24-hour clock, from a market that does not need a mainland identity.

identity_cost.detail: An 8591 account plus a Taiwanese payment rail. Not a mainland identity wall, but not anonymous either; the registration fields were not read.

reliability_note: A single seller account with 998 stock, not a platform guarantee of the pan access behind it.
confidence_note: The listing page was read in full: price, delivery window, stock, payment methods and the pan list are all quoted from it.

evidence.proved: '單件價格 $10', '24小時内交貨', '(庫存998件)', payment 7-11/全家/萊爾福/OK/玉山帳户, pan list 百度／夸克／騰訊／迅雷／阿里雲／115／UC／城通／天翼／飛貓／微雲／移動／堅果／小飛機, 刊登時間 2026-09-07

notes: NT$10 is about ¥2.3. Included as the non-mainland variant of the Taobao model: same per-item pricing, different identity wall.
binding_note: One item per order with a 24-hour window is the wall: the price per byte is unknowable in advance and the throughput is a human, so this is a route for a handful of files, not a terabyte.
